opportunities.title: Bug: express.json() has no body-size limit — oversized payloads exhaust memory and error as 500
opportunities.summary: ## Problem `app.use(express.json())` in `createApp()` registers the JSON body parser with no `limit`, so request bodies of arbitrary size are buffered in memory — a cheap memory-exhaustion DoS on every `POST` route. Additionally, when the body parser *does* reject an oversized body (`entity.too.large`), the thrown error reaches `errorHandler` which maps it to a generic `500` — clients get a server-error instead of `413 Payload Too Large`. ## Expected behavior - JSON bodies are capped (e.g. `100kb`) at the parser. - Oversized bodies return `413` with the standard JSON envelope `{ success: false, message }` — not a 500 and not an HTML error page. - Normal-sized payloads behave as before. ## Scope This issue is limited to the JSON body-size cap in `apps/api/src/app.js`, the `entity.too.large` -> `413` mapping in `errorHandler`, and focused route tests. This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. opportunities.title: Binance CSV: Simple Earn redemption can miss accrued interest
opportunities.summary: Precondition: Token migration #191 The token migration implementation revealed a bug in the `book.py` CoinTaxman currently underestimates the balance of assets held in Binance Simple Earn when a redemption includes accrued interest that was not fully exported as explicit reward rows. Example with GAL: ``` 2022-11-13 Simple Earn Flexible Subscription -0.91324704 GAL ... Explicit Earn rewards accumulated +0.00500300 GAL 2024-07-12 Simple Earn Flexible Redemption +0.91983573 GAL ``` The expected balance before redemption is therefore: `0.91324704 + 0.00500300 = 0.91825004 GAL` but Binance actually redeems: `0.91983573 GAL` so `0.00158569 GAL` of accrued interest is missing from the explicit reward history. Later, when Binance migrates GAL to G: ``` 2024-07-17 Asset Recovery -0.92483873 GAL 2024-07-17 Token Swap - Distribution +55.4903238 G ``` CoinTaxman fails with: `Not enough GAL in queue to sell: missing 0.00158569 GAL` The proposed fix is to reconcile `Simple Earn Flexible Redemption` against the tracked Earn principal + explicit Earn rewards and treat any positive difference as implicit `CoinLendInterest`.
